subject: general
question: The emergency brake locks the wheels by bypassing which system?
solution:
The correct answer is __Hydraulic brake system**(Option 4)**.__

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• The emergency brake__ is a braking system designed for use in urgent situations.
 
• It works by bypassing the hydraulic brake system, which is the primary braking system in most vehicles.
 
• The emergency brake system often operates mechanically, using cables to apply force to the wheels.
 
• This mechanism ensures that the vehicle can be stopped even if the hydraulic system fails.
 
• It is also commonly used to keep the vehicle stationary when parked.

**__Additional Information__**

 
• **Air Pressure System:**

 
 
• This system is used in heavy vehicles like trucks and buses for braking purposes.
 
• It works by compressing air to generate the force needed to apply brakes.
 
 
 
• **Fuel Injection System:**
 
 
• This system is responsible for delivering fuel into the combustion chamber of an engine.
 
• It does not have any direct connection to the braking systems.
 
 
 
• **Electric Brake System:**
 
 
• Commonly used in electric and hybrid vehicles.
 
• This system uses electronic controls to apply braking force.
